script_text: What if the ritual you're doing right now is charging your fear? On November 24th, the Moon peaks at 2 degrees Gemini, directly opposing the Sun in Sagittarius. It's an air-sign ritual, ruled by Mercury, that blazes across your 1st House of self and your 7th House of partnership. Expect an old flame to resurface as Venus in Scorpio, in your 6th House, trines Neptune retrograde in Aries in your 11th. At work, Mercury conjunct the Sun in your 10th House brings overdue recognition, but don't sign until after the Moon squares Saturn in Pisces in your 11th. Chiron retrograde in Aries in your 11th exposes the karmic lesson: your North Node won't let you outgrow old wounds until you name them. Write your intention on paper, then burn it at moonrise. Comment your rising sign for your personal ritual.
